propositions: The per-edge, same-edge guarantee of the _CASCADING_EDGES enumerated table does not prevent two documented-intended residuals: a closed child transitioning to in_progress under an open parent without cascading, and a blocked child resuming to in_progress under an open parent without cascading the parent.

The store enforces a required invariant that no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket, maintained jointly by the cascade table's two closed-source rows and the unconditional open-children close guard in transition_close.py, not by a total status ordering predicate.

The blocked→in_progress transition fires the start-work gate but does not cascade because only a blocked parent could be eligible on that edge, and auto-resuming an independently blocked parent would be incorrect; additionally, a blocked child can never exist under a closed ancestor due to the close guard.

Documentation in docs/concurrency.md §I4a must be narrowed from the overstated headline 'a child never runs ahead of its parent' to accurately reflect the per-edge guarantees and document the two accepted residuals with their reasons.
